remarks:
***** Drastically reduced***** The seller is ready to get this house SOLD! This is a big beautiful house with beautiful woodwork over 100 years old! They dont make'em like this any more!!! Conveniently located just a couple of blocks from downtown Cuba.  As you enter, your eyes are immediately drawn to the elegant staircase and the intricate wood details that showcase the home's timeless character. Large windows flood the rooms with natural light, highlighting the rich hardwood floors, beautiful trim work, and original wood panels beneath the windows.

To the left of the foyer, a grand pocket door opens into the parlor, currently used as a playroom. This bright and inviting space would make a wonderful sitting room, home office, library, or music room. Moving through additional pocket doors, you'll enter the spacious living room—what many would call today's family room—where more oversized windows create a warm and cheerful atmosphere.

The kitchen has been updated and offers an efficient, functional layout. Beyond the kitchen is the formal dining room, a good space for hosting family gatherings, holiday celebrations, and dinner parties. This home was truly designed for entertaining. A full bathroom completes the first floor, with a second full bathroom conveniently located upstairs.

The second floor features four generously sized bedrooms and a large open landing at the top of the stairs that could serve as a reading nook, office space, hobby area, or additional sitting room. One bedroom is currently being used for storage while the owners prepare for their move. Toward the rear of the home, you'll discover the original "servants' staircase," a fascinating reminder of the home's history that once provided direct access to the kitchen from the upstairs quarters.

Please note that some of the listing photos have been lightly edited to minimize the appearance of everyday family life, toys, and moving preparations. When you visit in person, you may notice signs of an active household—but you'll also experience firsthand the beauty, character, and history that make this home truly one of a kind.
